plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published in the 2023-2024 catalog (pp. 72-73). Lower bounds used for all ranges: ENGL 1A/1AS (4 or 5) sequenced as ENGL 1A 4 units; MATH 13 (+213 Support Course) (4 or 6) sequenced as MATH 13 4 units — the +213 support course is optional/conditional and not sequenced; SOC 120 or GEOG 14 (3-4) sequenced as SOC 120 3 units. Sequenced lower bounds sum to 61 while the catalog states a 60-unit degree total; total_credits follows the sequenced sum per rule. Category mapping: catalog REQUIREMENT 'GE' -> core, 'Major' (incl. 'Major, List A/B/C') -> major, 'Elective' -> elective; 'US History' and 'US/CA Politics' mapped to core. Sequence tables list no prerequisites, so prereq lists are empty. The local (non-transfer) Anthropology AA in the same catalog lists requirements but no sequence — recorded as an honest negative. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
